pages.text: Press $(k:key.jobsplus.open_menu) to open the Jobs menu and join two jobs. A job levels up from its own work and pays one $(item)job coin$() per level.$(br2)Spend coins in the same menu on power-ups, or on a third job.

The ten jobs: Alchemist, Builder, Digger, Enchanter, Farmer, Fisherman, Hunter, Lumberjack, Miner and Smith.$(br2)Four of them also $(l)make$() things nobody else can: Smith, Hunter, Enchanter and Alchemist.
